# Zaydtex

> Zaydtex is the trade and wholesale brand of Korteks Textiles Africa (Pty) Ltd, one of the largest vertically integrated textile producers in Africa. Ready-made curtains, curtain fabric and a full home-textile range are made from yarn to finished product under one roof in Centurion, Gauteng, South Africa, and supplied to the trade nationwide. Trade and wholesale enquiries only.

Key facts:
- Manufacturer: Korteks Textiles Africa (Pty) Ltd, 14 Sesmylspruit Street, Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, 0157, Gauteng, South Africa
- Output: almost 1,000,000 ready-made curtains a year
- Factory: 19,000 m² under one roof in Centurion; more than 250 skilled people
- Ownership: 100% South African owned and run; B-BBEE contributor
- In-house processes: warping, knitting (lace and sheers), weaving (jacquards and wovens), embroidery, dyeing and finishing, cut-make-trim (CMT), and eight quality checks before packing
- Ready-made curtains are packaged and barcoded in-house
- Customers: independent retailers, national chains, wholesalers, curtain shops, furniture stores, interior designers, hospitality groups, property developers, construction and industrial buyers
- Contact: +27 12 666 7100 · sales@zaydtex.com · trade enquiries answered within 1 business day

## Product range

- [Ready-made curtains](https://www.zaydtex.com/get-a-quote?product=Ready-Made%20Curtains): Made, packaged and barcoded in-house, ready for retail shelves or projects
- [Curtain fabric by the metre](https://www.zaydtex.com/get-a-quote?product=Curtain%20Fabric%20by%20the%20Metre): Curtain fabric cut to requirement, any quantity
- [Curtain fabric by the roll](https://www.zaydtex.com/get-a-quote?product=Curtain%20Fabric%20by%20the%20Roll): Full rolls of curtain fabric for the trade
- [Table cloths](https://www.zaydtex.com/get-a-quote?product=Table%20Cloths): Table linen for hospitality and retail
- [Scatter cushions](https://www.zaydtex.com/get-a-quote?product=Scatter%20Cushions): Coordinating cushions to finish a range
- [Towelling products](https://www.zaydtex.com/get-a-quote?product=Towelling%20Products): The ZaHa snag-proof towelling range
- [Dress forms](https://www.zaydtex.com/get-a-quote?product=Dress%20Forms): Plain and adjustable dress forms in every size
